category_title: Year 4 pupil with ADHD symptoms (hyperactivity, impulsivity, and learning difficulties)
minimal_context: Yiannis is expected to remain seated at his desk and work on his reading assignment during the 90-minute Literacy block.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are starting our 90-minute Literacy block now. Please sit at your desk and begin your reading assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks highly distracted and moves back and forth in his chair in a nervous manner.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at your book and keep trying to read.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows great difficulty sitting on his chair, constantly moving back and forth without looking at the assignment.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yiannis, you need to stay in your seat and do your work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves his seat completely and begins moving around in the classroom.)
